dataset_note: All prompts are synthetic public test cases.

evals.prompt: 帮我把发布流程画成图：产品确认范围 → 开发 → 代码评审 → 测试 → 灰度 → 全量上线。
evals.expected_output: A complete warm flowchart delivered as safe HTML without blocking on a style questionnaire or generating an unrequested PNG.
assertions: Selects flowchart and a suitable style.
Preserves the six supplied stages and their order.
Does not add extra gates or reorder the six supplied stages.
Validates and audits the rendered HTML.
Does not generate a PNG because the user did not request one.

evals.prompt: Compare PostgreSQL and MySQL on performance, extensibility, JSON support, ecosystem, and learning cost. I have not supplied benchmarks and I am not asking you to pick a winner.
evals.expected_output: A neutral comparison layout using only grounded statements; the user's explicit no-benchmarks, no-winner constraints are honored.
assertions: Does not add a recommended badge or declare a winner.
Aligns the five supplied comparison dimensions.

evals.prompt: Create a glass architecture diagram: Web client → API gateway → User service and Order service. Both services use Redis; each has its own PostgreSQL database.
evals.expected_output: A layered architecture diagram with the exact supplied components and relationships.
assertions: Shows two services, one shared Redis, and two separate PostgreSQL databases.
Keeps the supplied topology exact; any added labels use plausible defaults.

evals.prompt: 做一个数据看板，指标名是活跃用户、成功率、平均时延，但我暂时没有提供具体数值。
evals.expected_output: A dashboard whose three metric cards carry plausible example values drawn straight in, delivered without blocking on a request for numbers.
assertions: Fills the three cards with plausible, internally consistent example values.
Delivers the dashboard as-is with no assumption labels and no clarifying round-trip.

evals.prompt: Plot a regression scatter chart with confidence intervals from this CSV.
evals.expected_output: Route to a statistical plotting workflow rather than using text2html2png.
assertions: Does not force the request into one of the eight static diagram types.

evals.prompt: 把这个流程做成 HTML，并同时导出一张 4× PNG：Draft → Review → Publish。
evals.expected_output: A validated HTML flowchart plus a 4× PNG because the user explicitly requested the image export.
assertions: Exports a PNG at the requested scale.
Preserves the three supplied stages without adding steps.
